findings.title: Never add Co-Authored-By: Claude to commits or PRs
findings.message: The changelog includes "Co-Authored-By: Claude <noreply@anthropic.com>" which violates the policy. Commit messages, PR descriptions, and review comments must not contain AI-attribution trailers.

claims.reason: The diff for CHANGELOG.md shows the line "Co-Authored-By: Claude <noreply@anthropic.com>" was added.

claims.claim: Including "Co-Authored-By: Claude <noreply@anthropic.com>" in the changelog violates the policy.
claims.reason: The rule document states that commit messages, PR descriptions, and review comments must not contain `Co-Authored-By: Claude` and the changelog is part of the PR description which falls under this policy.

claims.claim: Commit messages, PR descriptions, and review comments must not contain AI-attribution trailers.
claims.reason: This is a direct quote from the rule document.
